workflows.description: executable physics derivation autoformalization over SymPy using anchored source extraction, informal expansion, quantity binding, equation surfaces, contextual assumptions, dimensional and unit modeling, implicit gap closure, physical law grounding, artifact execution, execution interpretation, equational semantics critics, final equation reviewers, localized monotonic refinement, numeric sanity sampling, and reference-free consistency metrics.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered sympy_physics_derivation_trace_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared sympy_physics_derivation_trace_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by sympy_physics_derivation_trace_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Recover a source-grounded physical derivation, expose and execute its SymPy surface, review it, route bounded repairs, and report status.
reasoning_projection.name: ReconstructWithSympy

occurrences.rationale: Recover source-anchored laws, assumptions, regimes, and intended target.
Model quantities, units, dimensions, regimes, and frames.
Propose explicit bridges for detected derivation gaps without claiming proof.
Align the physical model with applicable SymPy APIs and assumptions.
Draft the executable physics derivation artifact.
Execute the artifact and classify its concrete diagnostics.
Assess steps, units, samples, and final mathematical equations.
Assess physical meaning, dimensions, regimes, and governing laws.
Route localized repairs, map their expansion frontier, and decide whether the bounded loop should recurse or block.
Assess whether the grounded sample exercises the required source, equation, law, API, and reasoning-log surfaces.
Report the executed run together with open repair and revalidation obligations.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one source-to-execution SymPy physics review and repair-routing episode; no claim that routed repairs ran
